answer_text:
For a five-person team you want something that's quick to set up, keeps the pipeline visible and doesn't need an admin. These are the strongest options right now:

1. Northwind CRM Essentials - the safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace.
2. Sheetly - spreadsheet-based CRM templates — free and familiar, but they break down past a few hundred contacts.
3. Brightdesk - a help desk with light CRM features — fine if support is your main workflow.

Start with Northwind CRM if you want the quickest setup; shortlist Sheetly if you expect to need deeper reporting.
